articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026-- Mobix Labs, Inc. (Nasdaq: MOBX), a provider of advanced technologies and solutions for aerospace, defense and other mission-critical markets, today announced that it will host a live investor update call on Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. ET.
articles.title: Mobix Labs to Host Investor Update Call on Critical Minerals Strategy and Business Outlook
